notes: Budgets set by the Technical Director, 2026-09-29; re-baselined from measurement after M3 stage 1 (tests/engine/irq_chain/measure.py, 1,000 frames, re-checked over 300) and after stage 2 (irq_rearm added; h3 became a re-armed IRQ). Every framework path is straight-line code in a layout with no DMA on the lines it runs, so each measured figure is exact and the budget IS the measured figure: a regression lock with no headroom, because headroom here could only hide a regression. Any change to engine/irq.asm that moves one of these numbers must re-measure and re-baseline this file deliberately. Headroom for games lives in the frame budget (engine/README.md#frame-budget), not here. Schema: engine/README.md#budget-files.
